name: Question 9
problem:
A body of mass $3\,\text{kg}$ is moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis under the action of a single force $F,$ measured in Newtons.
At time $t$ seconds, the position of the body is given by $s(t)={e}^{2t}-{t}^{3}$ meters.
Find the expression for the force acting on the body at time $t.$

A body of mass 3kg is moving in a straight line along the x-axis under the action of a single force F, measured in Newtons. At time t seconds, the position of the body is given by s(t)=e2t−t3 meters. Find the expression for the force acting on the body at time t.

24e2t−12t
b
12e2t−18t
c
12e2t−6t
d
18e2t−12t
